primitives.name: Event Taxonomy Design
primitives.verbatim_quote: # NEXT-024: Notification event taxonomy ## Repo(s) Novu, PostHog ## Category Lifecycle ## Goal Implement or design the notification event taxonomy capability for GSE / GSN without touching production data first.
primitives.assumptions: Taxonomy must be modular, non-intrusive, and scalable across user lifecycle stages.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when event categorization introduces ambiguity or misalignment with user intent.

layer2.mapping: The event taxonomy \( \mathcal{T} \) is isomorphic to a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of user journey stages, where each node represents a notification trigger.
layer2.telemetry: Event classification accuracy and coverage rate in simulated user flows.

primitives.name: Autonomous Operation Capability
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Why It Matters This increases GSE's ability to operate autonomously, learn from users, improve conversion, reduce SaaS cost, and make product/marketing decisions from evidence.
primitives.assumptions: Autonomy depends on feedback loops that update internal models based on observed user behavior.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Operational collapse when learning signal-to-noise ratio drops below threshold.

layer2.mapping: Derived from event taxonomy, this kernel enables autonomous decision-making via reinforcement-like updates over user engagement metrics.
layer2.telemetry: Conversion rate improvement and SaaS cost reduction metrics.

primitives.name: Legal Compliance Boundary
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Legal / License Boundary Novu: MIT core plus enterprise/proprietary folders and ee packages under separate licenses; PostHog: MIT Expat for repo content outside ee; enterprise code under separate license Do not copy source code from these repos into GSE.
primitives.assumptions: Codebase integrity must remain compliant with open-source licensing constraints.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Compliance breach upon unauthorized code inclusion or derivative misuse.

layer2.mapping: License compliance is modeled as a constraint set \( \mathcal{L} \subseteq \mathcal{S} \), ensuring all implemented features adhere to permitted usage domains.
layer2.telemetry: Audit logs of third-party dependency usage and license validation reports.

reasoning_traces.think:
The notification event taxonomy is structured as a categorical state transition system \( \mathcal{T} = \{T_i\}_{i=1}^n \), where each \( T_i \) corresponds to a distinct user lifecycle stage. This system enables GSI to perform Bayesian inference on event likelihood given context \( P(E|C) \), facilitating autonomous operation through learned user preferences. The GSE leverages this taxonomy to compute situational reasoning \( \mathcal{R}(s_t, \mathcal{T}) \to a_{t+1} \), enabling adaptive actions. Legal boundaries are enforced by ensuring \( \mathcal{L} \subseteq \mathcal{S} \), preventing unauthorized code reuse. Failure modes include ambiguous event classification, operational drift due to poor feedback loops, and compliance violations from improper integration.
